UPDATE: Pansamantalang sinuspinde ng Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) ang flight training operations ng Topflite Academy of Aviation Inc. sa loob ng pitong araw matapos mag-crash ang Cessna RP-C2211 training aircraft nito malapit sa Iba Airport sa Zambales, Biyernes ng umaga, Hulyo 11. | DZRH News

CAAP Press Release
July 11, 2025

CAAP suspends operations of flying school following Iba Airport incident

The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) has ordered the suspension of all flight training operations of Topflite Academy of Aviation Inc. (TAAI) following an incident involving one of its aircraft near Iba Airport in Zambales.

The incident occurred around 9:31 AM on Friday, July 11, 2025, involving a training flight aboard Cessna RP-C2211.

All four (4) passengers are safe and have received medical attention.

CAAP has immediately suspended TAAI’s flight training operations for a period of seven (7) days.

The flight instructor and student pilots involved have also been administratively grounded to ensure the independence of the investigation being conducted by the Aircraft Accident Investigation and Inquiry Board (AAIIB).

CAAP has summoned TAAI’s Quality Manager, Safety Manager, flight instructor, student pilots, and other relevant personnel to explain the incident.

CAAP remains committed to upholding the highest standards of aviation safety and remains steadfast in its mandate to safeguard the public, in accordance with the guidance of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and the Department of Transportation.
